caption: The drawing features a single ornate teapot rendered within a rectangular border on a lightly yellowed background. The teapot is seen in profile and has a bulbous, multi-paneled body with rounded vertical segments. It sits on a short pedestal base with a decorative band around the bottom. The handle on the left is angular and has a distinct rectangular, stepped shape with curved elements at the base, and the spout on the right is long, thin, and curves upward. The hinged lid is domed with a small knob on top and a decorative band just below the rim. There is extensive fine linework in graphite to show shading and reflective surfaces, with light touches of blue, pink, and yellow colored pencil added, suggesting highlights and reflections on the metallic surface. The detailing includes bands of repeated motifs around the upper and lower sections of the teapot and a slight reflection of color near the base, indicating a polished, shiny surface. The drawing is contained within a hand-drawn rectangular frame, and there is a faint handwritten note near the upper right edge.
title: Teapot
